metrics_source: simple_metrics.csv, the upstream preprocessing default; all KPIs of all services in the window retained.
tool_query_domain: Any service_name; query second within the selected trace span seconds. Each trace package holds every full-data metric row within 1200 s and every served log row within 60 s of its window; all belong to its case.
data_policy: Only selected train cases. Labels in traces/*/scoring/; never forwarded to model. Private Kaggle use only.

tool_result_budget.share: The search_logs calls of one model response share the budget equally: floor(2048 / n) tokens each. Metric results are not budgeted.
tool_result_budget.rule: Results within their share pass byte-for-byte. Larger results are merged by exact duplicates, then by masked message template, then truncated by severity priority, whichever first fits; a notice line tells the model. Applied by smoke-worker.py outside the unchanged upstream code.

condition_design.components: telemetry-gap.py: gap_aware = missing-source notice, trace_kpi = trace-derived latency KPI for absent metrics, trace_expand = window evidence table in the final prompt.
